`serialize.unserialize` deserializes input with an API that reconstructs behaviour (functions, prototypes, or arbitrary object graphs), not just data. Whoever controls the serialized bytes controls what is rebuilt in this process. Use a data-only format such as JSON with an explicit schema check.
